name: Kloss
summary: The Kloss EA is a mean-reversion trading system that uses CCI, Stochastic, and LWMA to identify overbought/oversold conditions for entry. It opens buy positions when CCI is deeply oversold, Stochastic main is below a threshold, and price is above the MA, and vice versa for sell signals. It features an MWMode mechanism that defers SL/TP placement until after position open to avoid broker rejection on tight stops.
summary_zh: Kloss EA是一个均值回归交易系统，使用CCI、随机指标和LWMA来识别超买超卖条件进行入场。当CCI深度超卖、随机指标主线下穿阈值且价格高于均线时买入，反之卖出。它具有MWMode机制，在仓位建立后再设置止损止盈，以避免因止损距离过近而被券商拒绝。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于均值回归概念，认为价格偏离均值后会回归。入场条件：买入信号要求CCI低于-CCIDiffer（默认-120）、随机指标主线低于50-StDiffer（默认30）、且收盘价高于LWMA均线；卖出信号则相反，CCI高于+CCIDiffer、随机指标高于50+StDiffer、收盘价低于均线。出场条件有两种：一是止损止盈触发（默认各550点），二是当RevClose开启时，反向信号出现即平仓。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于风险的动态手数计算，当Lots=0时使用账户自由保证金乘以MaximumRisk计算手数。资金管理通过fLotsNormalize函数将手数规范化为符合券商最小手数和步长要求。MWMode机制是一个巧妙设计，先用0止损止盈开仓，然后在下一个tick通过PositionModify设置真实止损止盈，并调整至满足StopsLevel要求，避免开仓时止损过近被拒绝。
strategy_analysis_en: This strategy is based on the mean reversion concept, assuming that prices will revert to the mean after deviating. Entry conditions: a buy signal requires CCI below -CCIDiffer (default -120), Stochastic main line below 50-StDiffer (default 30), and close price above the LWMA; sell signals are the mirror opposite with CCI above +CCIDiffer, Stochastic above 50+StDiffer, and close below the MA. Exit conditions come in two forms: stop loss/take profit triggers (default 550 points each), or reverse signal closure when RevClose is enabled. Position sizing supports both fixed lots and risk-based dynamic lot calculation, where Lots=0 triggers calculation using account free margin multiplied by MaximumRisk divided by 1000. Money management is handled by fLotsNormalize which rounds lot size to conform with broker minimum volume and step requirements. The MWMode mechanism is a clever design that opens positions with zero SL/TP first, then modifies them on subsequent ticks via PositionModify, adjusting to satisfy StopsLevel requirements and avoiding rejection for stops being too close at order time.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description: 固定手数，为0时使用动态风险计算

parameters.name: MaximumRisk
parameters.description: 风险比例，当Lots=0时用于动态计算手数
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage for dynamic lot calculation when Lots=0

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points; 0 disables stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points; 0 disables take profit

parameters.name: RevClose
parameters.description: 是否在出现反向信号时平仓

parameters.name: MAMethod
parameters.description: MA均线方法，默认线性加权移动平均
parameters.description_en: MA method; default is linear weighted moving average

parameters.name: CCIDiffer
parameters.description_en: CCI threshold level for deviation from zero

parameters.name: StShift
parameters.description: 随机指标检查的K线偏移

parameters.name: StDiffer
parameters.description: 随机指标阈值，双向偏离50的水平

parameters.name: CommonShift
parameters.description: 通用偏移，加到所有指标的Shift变量上
parameters.description_en: Common shift added to all indicator Shift variables

parameters.name: MWMode
parameters.description: 是否在开仓后设置止损止盈（避免开仓时被拒）
parameters.description_en: Set SL/TP after open to avoid rejection

pros: 三重指标过滤（CCI+随机+MA）减少了虚假信号，入场条件较严格
MWMode机制巧妙解决了止损过近被券商拒绝的问题，提高了开仓成功率
仓位管理支持固定手数和动态风险计算两种模式，灵活性好
止损止盈对称设置且均可设为0关闭，给交易者充分的参数调节空间
指标参数和偏移参数均可调，便于优化和回测不同时间框架
pros_en: Triple indicator filter (CCI + Stochastic + MA) reduces false signals with strict entry conditions
The MWMode mechanism cleverly solves the problem of broker rejection for stops being too close, improving order fill rates
Position sizing supports both fixed lots and dynamic risk-based calculation, offering good flexibility
Symmetric SL/TP that can each be set to 0 to disable, giving traders ample parameter tuning space
All indicator parameters and shift offsets are adjustable, facilitating optimization and backtesting across timeframes
cons: MAPeriod默认为1，周期为1的LWMA本质上就是价格本身，作为过滤器意义不大
动态手数计算公式（FreeMargin*MaximumRisk/1000）缺乏理论依据，未考虑止损距离
SolveLots函数中rv变量始终为true，没有实际的手数有效性验证
没有新K线检查机制（仅用ZeroBar或时间比较），在ZeroBar为true时可能每tick都交易
没有点差过滤，在点差较大时仍可能入场，对均值回归策略不利
cons_en: MAPeriod defaults to 1, making the LWMA essentially the price itself, which severely weakens its filtering purpose
The dynamic lot formula (FreeMargin * MaximumRisk / 1000) lacks theoretical basis and does not account for stop loss distance
The rv variable in SolveLots is always true with no actual lot validity verification, making the return value meaningless
No proper new bar check mechanism; when ZeroBar is true, trading logic may execute on every tick
No spread filter — entries can occur during wide spreads, which is detrimental for a mean reversion strategy
improvements: 将MAPeriod默认值从1改为合理周期（如14-20），使MA真正起到趋势过滤作用
改进动态手数计算，应基于止损距离计算风险，即手数=风险金额/（止损点数*每点价值），这是标准的仓位管理方法
添加点差过滤，当点差超过阈值时不入场，避免滑点过大
improvements_en: Change MAPeriod default from 1 to a reasonable period (e.g., 14-20) so the MA actually serves as a trend filter
Improve dynamic lot calculation to risk-based sizing: lots = risk amount / (stop loss points * point value), which is the standard position sizing approach
Add a spread filter to prevent entries when the spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding excessive slippage

risk_points: MAPeriod=1使MA过滤失效，策略缺少趋势方向确认，可能在逆势中频繁入场
手数计算未考虑止损距离，高波动品种可能导致单笔风险过大
ZeroBar为true时缺乏有效的新K线检查，可能导致同一根K线内重复交易
risk_points_en: MAPeriod=1 disables the MA filter, leaving the strategy without trend direction confirmation and potentially causing frequent counter-trend entries
Lot calculation ignores stop loss distance, which can lead to excessive per-trade risk on volatile instruments
When ZeroBar is true, there is no effective new bar check, potentially causing repeated trades within the same bar

summary_en: The Kloss EA is a mean-reversion trading system that uses CCI, Stochastic, and LWMA to identify overbought/oversold conditions for entry. It opens buy positions when CCI is deeply oversold, Stochastic main is below a threshold, and price is above the MA, and vice versa for sell signals. It features an MWMode mechanism that defers SL/TP placement until after position open to avoid broker rejection on tight stops.
